reply_text:
I replied to Ilse in our DM to say I'll keep the rumoured move to Bay 35 to myself. I told them I won't mention it in any channel or to anyone else, and that I'll help announce it if it's confirmed.

I didn't save the rumour to GBrain or to memory, because both are shared and saving it there could expose it. My only lookup was a GBrain search to get the background. It found the incident channel from 2025-09-03, when the carrier API outage stalled label printing at the Tansley Parcel depots. Nothing in it mentions Bay 35. I didn't need to quote any of it in the reply.
